query: When is the best time to visit Valley of the Kings?
answer:
The best time to visit the Valley of the Kings is from October to February, when the weather is mild and comfortable, with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 25°C. Avoid visiting during the peak summer months (June to August) as it can get extremely hot, with temperatures often reaching 40°C. If you prefer fewer crowds, consider visiting early in the morning or late in the afternoon.
